title: Introduce Db, Protocol Command Layer And Vcs Slimming
description: Introduce a new `db` server-database technology integrating `pack` (immutable binary documents), a new `protocol` technology (command/collaboration semantics + binary formats, extracted from vcs/framework-core, merged with the existing open PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER contract), and a slimmed `vcs` (version-graph semantics only). Rebuild os-hub and compose-hub on db with a redesigned binary wire protocol (protocol_wire); refactor framework/sync, framework/plugin, framework/core, and all ~40 app plugin crates onto the new protocol traits. Full feature-complete db: WAL (reusing protocol's .spr container), pack-based snapshots, persistent diff-state overlays, projections, query engine, indexes, ephemeral previews, conflict resolution, replica sync, cluster leases/fencing/replication, security, compaction/GC, observability, CLI, testkit, benchmarks. Storage backends for db and the hub identity directory must be swappable: filesystem (default), sqlite, postgres, neo4j. Executed via a parallel-agent Workflow campaign (CW0-CW9) per the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/introduce-a-new-technology-cuddly-rabbit.md. This ticket covers CW0: opening the ticket, amending the PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER contract with the semantics-layer crates, and writing the campaign contract.md that freezes crate lists, trait signatures, WAL record kinds, wire frames, and region names before fan-out.
summary:
CW9 (final wave) closes the db+protocol+vcs-slimming campaign (CW0-CW9). Campaign recap: introduced `protocol` (12-crate command/collaboration + binary-format technology, merging the frozen PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER contract), slimmed `vcs` to version-graph semantics, built the full `db` server technology (24 crates: catalog, actors, WAL, pack-based snapshots, projections, query engine, indexes, previews, conflict resolution, replica sync, cluster leases, security, compaction, observability, CLI, testkit — with swappable fs/sqlite/postgres/neo4j storage), rewired wire-protocol-v2 client integration into framework/sync, rebuilt both os-hub and compose-hub on db, fanned the migration out across ~50 app/plugin crates, and closed with CW8's shim removal + 3 new policy lints. The earlier PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER ticket (#2362) was closed with its scope merged into this campaign at CW0.

CW9 verification (full details + raw logs in cw9-final-report.txt and cw9-*.txt in this folder): cargo build --workspace clean (0 errors); clippy clean of errors across the full touched surface (protocol/* x12, db/* x24, vcs, framework-core/sync/plugin, os-hub, compose-hub, compose client, and effectively every CW7 fan-out crate — 1139/4/949 pre-existing style warnings only); leveled tests green including SEMIO_TEST_LEVEL=exhaustive for protocol_testkit/pack_testkit/db_testkit (crash-harness + byte-truncation + bit-flip corruption fuzz suites all pass); os-hub's 9-test integration suite (reconnect-via-resume-token, WS duplex fan-out, blob CAS round-trip) and compose-hub's 91-test suite both green. Found and FIXED a real regression during this wave: CW7's vcs::OpText -> protocol::OpText rename broke an older, unrelated policy-lint regex (`POLICY_HAND_ROLLED_IMPL_RE` in script.ts) that only recognized a `vcs::` prefix, causing 11 false-positive dsl-migration/completeness breaches; widened it to also accept `protocol::`. All 3 new CW8 policy lints (policyProtocolMigrationBreaches, policyDbServerOnlyBreaches, policyCommandEnvelopeCompletenessBreaches) are 0-breach after the fix, with the command-envelope allowlist correctly non-empty (~55 seeded files). The 21 remaining individual test failures (across cad-plugin/draw-plugin/gis-plugin/note-plugin/puzzle_2d/raster-plugin) and compose client's 12 failures were cross-checked name-for-name against every prior wave's own documented baseline and confirmed pre-existing/unrelated (icon-catalogue lookup panics and a CSS-color-parser bug in unrelated crates, plus pre-existing compose kit-graph churn) — zero new regressions. Storybook's full production build fails, but for a pre-existing, cross-campaign reason unrelated to db/protocol/vcs (coda/client/ui/desktop/js/renderer.tsx importing a nonexistent @semio-tech/framework-platform-core package, dating to a June 25 commit) — independently reconfirmed today by the separate, already-closed FIX-STORYBOOK-BUILD-BROKEN-BY-PUZZLE-DSL-FIXTURE-MIGRATION ticket.

Compiled a full human-todo list (AGENTS.md rewrites for playbook/protocol/db; preview-law wire-up for 5 gesture apps needing a vcs::BackboneMessage::Preview variant + WIT changes + host relay; compose's still-stubbed client-side wire-v2 network wiring; the icon-catalogue gap; db_engine/db_cluster integration gaps; postgres/neo4j storage backends needing testcontainers-based integration coverage; and ~20 smaller documented follow-ups) — full list in cw9-final-report.txt, nothing here was fixed by CW9 per instructions (collection only).
